tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page and app background. Ground for ink, ink-2, muted, accent-ink.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Panels, editor, upload box, menus, toasts. Same text tokens as bg.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track, badges, user chat bubbles, address pill, code snippets.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Hover and current-item fill for buttons, rows, tree items. Text on it stays ink or ink-2.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumbs and heavy separators. Not a text ground.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Preview and compare stage behind the rendered component.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline: panel edges, section rules, list dividers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, select, outline-button and drop-zone borders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, panel, raised, hover.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Body copy inside the app (assistant messages, file names, notices) on every surface.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, labels, metadata, fine print, placeholders. 4.5:1 on bg, panel, raised; on hover 4.5 dark / 4.9 light.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: NON-TEXT only: inactive icons, gutter numbers, the slash in breadcrumbs. 3:1 on bg and panel. Never body text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary action fill (one per view), selected step marker. Light theme fills with Graphite because lime fails on Chalk.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent used as text, focus ring, modified-file dot, active indicator on bg and panel (5.6:1 light).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selection, highlighted code lines, drag-over drop zone.

tokens.usage: Compare swipe handle and drop-zone drag border.

tokens.name: mark-caret
tokens.usage: The caret bar of the logo mark.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors: failed step, compile error title icon, validation text. Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warnings: offline bar icon, edited-file note, limit reached.

tokens.name: ok
